item.tib: dpal gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las sdud pa dbang gi phyag cha
item.coloph: kho bo dran pa nam mkha' bdag 'di 'dra ba'i gdams pa khyad par can/ ri rgyal lhun po'i gnas mchog tu/ nam mkha' snang mdog gshen la zhus/ shin tu nyes shing nye ba'i rgyud/ 'chi med gtsug phud man chad nas/ bdag rang yan chad rgyud pa brgyad/ stang chen nyid dang dgu ru ste/ phyi rab las ldan skyes bu la/ man ngag gcig rgyud gdams pa mdzod/ ces stang dmu tsha la gdams pa'o/ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i nyang phur/ mi dang mi min gyi gong non/ phyag cha las kyi 'khor lo e ya/ shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
